findings.note: Barry is on the House cosponsor list for SB 16 (2025), whose caption says it relates to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote, including a limited federal ballot for voters who cannot supply the proof. The bill history shows it left pending in the House Elections committee. The date he was added as cosponsor is not shown on the page.

Barry is on the coauthor list of HB 5337 (2025), relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and creating criminal offenses. The history shows the committee report sent to the House calendars on 2025-05-07. The date he was added is not on the page.
